title: Ya-Sin 36:9-12 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:9-12 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 15. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ (٩) وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ (١٠) إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ (١١) إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ (١٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:9-12 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:9-12 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:9-12 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, list three 'traces' (36:12) you hope to leave.
questions.a: e.g. teaching someone a surah; sadaqah jariyah; a good example to siblings.

questions.q: Recite 36:1 to 12 and name one madd of each type you meet.
questions.a: Tabi'i, muttasil (ءَابَآؤُهُمْ, وَسَوَآءٌ), munfasil (مَّآ أُنذِرَ), 'arid (stops), lazim harfi (يسٓ).

options: Whoever follows the reminder and fears the Most Merciful unseen
questions.a: A) Whoever follows the reminder and fears the Most Merciful unseen. 36:11: 'You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen'.

questions.q: Ya-Sin 36:11: «إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 36:12 says Allah records what people send ahead and the traces they leave behind. What 'traces' could you leave?
questions.a: Good deeds that continue after us: knowledge taught, charity, a good example (36:12).
